name: aartiq-mcp
description: AI-native browser with autonomous agent capabilities, local LLM support, OS automation, and cross-device sync. Provides browser control, web search, shell execution, PDF generation, and system automation tools.
long_description: Aartiq is an open-source, AI-native browser with autonomous agent capabilities. This MCP server exposes 24 tools for browser automation, web search, shell command execution, PDF generation, application search, system controls (volume, brightness, alarms), AppleScript/PowerShell execution, and cross-device sync. All operations are permission-gated with a triple-lock security model.
